caption: Need a quick but nutritious toddler meal? These versatile rice balls are always my go-to! 🍙✨ Ingredients: • Rice & cooked chicken  • ¼ avocado • 1 tbsp cottage cheese • Dash of garlic powder The best part is how customizable they are. Swap the protein, add different veggies, wrap them in seaweed, and make them your own. My toddler does a happy dance every time these hit her plate, so I’d say they’re a winner! 💃🏻🤍 #easyrecipe #babyledweaning #toddlermeals #toddlerrecipes #toddlerapproved
